description: This file defines the class 'FormattedCell' which handles the rendering and layout calculations for a table cell within the MigraDoc rendering framework. It manages content sizing, formatting, and area provisioning for a cell in a table in a document.

classes.name: FormattedCell
classes.description: Represents a formatted cell in a table, responsible for layout, rendering, and content measurement within the MigraDoc rendering system.

methods.name: FormattedCell
methods.description: Constructor initializing a FormattedCell with cell, renderer, borders, and positional offsets.

methods.name: GetNextArea
methods.description: Provides the next layout area for rendering content, calculated only once.

methods.name: ProbeNextArea
methods.description: Placeholder implementation returning null for probing next area.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Performs the formatting of the cell content using a graphics context.

methods.name: CalcContentRect
methods.description: Calculates the rectangle area occupied by the cell content based on column widths and paddings.

methods.name: ContentHeight
methods.description: Returns the total height of the cell content.

methods.name: InnerHeight
methods.description: Calculates the inner height of the cell, considering row height rules and paddings.

methods.name: InnerWidth
methods.description: Calculates the inner width of the cell, summing widths of merged columns minus border widths.

methods.name: AreaFieldInfos
methods.description: Provides field information associated with this area.

methods.name: StoreRenderInfos
methods.description: Stores rendering information into a list.

methods.name: IsAreaBreakBefore
methods.description: Indicates whether there is an area break before this cell.

methods.name: CalcContentHeight
methods.description: Calculates content height based on render info or paragraph line height and spacing.
